questions.question: What's a typical baseline tool stack for a solo founder building a SaaS product today?
questions.answer_summary: A commonly cited lean stack pairs an AI builder (Lovable or Cursor) with Supabase for data/auth, Lemon Squeezy for payments/tax, Plausible for analytics, and Resend for email - with total pre-revenue monthly cost cited at under $20 in one guide.

questions.question: Which AI coding assistant do solo founders rely on most in 2026?
questions.answer_summary: Cursor and Claude Code are repeatedly named as the dominant coding-assistant combination across 2026 indie-hacker content and founder surveys, with Cursor cited as crossing 1 million monthly active users in early 2026.

questions.question: Do solo founders use both ChatGPT and Claude, or just one?
questions.answer_summary: Many keep both, reportedly using Claude for deeper reasoning/writing work and ChatGPT for faster iteration/experimentation.

questions.question: What does a more 'aggressive' shipping stack add on top of the basics?
questions.answer_summary: Beyond the core builder+database+payments stack, more aggressive setups add app builders like Lovable/v0 plus Midjourney for rapid visual/product asset iteration, and workflow automation via n8n, Make, or Zapier.

questions.question: How fast can a solo founder actually go from idea to a live product using this stack?
questions.answer_summary: Guides describe going from a blank screen on a Friday evening to a live, publicly accessible deployed product by Sunday night as a realistic claim for the current AI-assisted stack.

questions.question: How many new micro-SaaS launches are now built by people with no prior coding background?
questions.answer_summary: One Indie Hackers-sourced figure cited in a 2026 stack guide put this at 34% of new micro-SaaS products launched in Q1 2026.

questions.question: What does a scaled-up (post-launch) solo founder stack cost per month?
questions.answer_summary: A mid-2026 guide placed ongoing scaling-stage operating costs at roughly $180-$400/month plus variable infrastructure costs, once a product has real usage.

questions.question: What tools handle the non-coding parts of running solo (CRM, workspace, automation)?
questions.answer_summary: Notion is frequently cited as the default 'operating system' for a solo founder, paired with automation via n8n/Make/Zapier and a lightweight CRM like GoHighLevel or HubSpot.
